request: Add the Acme orders table from the ERP to bronze. It has 40 million rows and an updated_at column that people say is unreliable. Make it a delta load.
must: Does not accept DELTA on trust: says DELTA needs a change column that moves on every change and is proven by comparing with a full copy, otherwise FULL_MERGE
Lands the extract in a PRE_BRONZE staging table first, so a failed load never empties bronze
Asks about the key (unique on the data, confirmed by the business) and runs a Duplicates gate on staging before the merge
Includes the ETL columns LOAD_TO_BRONZE_TS, IS_LAST_INSERT_TO_BRONZE_IND, ETL_INSERT_DATE, ETL_UPDATE_DATE and soft delete via DELETED_DATE
Advances the window only after the gate passes, and mentions the mass-delete guard
must_not: Truncates bronze before the extract has arrived whole
Takes column types from the column names instead of the source catalog
